title: A multiancestry polygenic risk score for Alzheimer's disease is associated with cognitive decline and neuropathological hallmarks in diverse populations.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Listed Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.20818015: R scripts, README, 20240821_AD_PRS_Weight.txt (54,826,765 bytes, over the 50 MB cap, not downloaded) and 20240820_Final_scaling_AD_PRSsum.csv (opened: one row, mean 3.0e-17, SD 0.3497). Listed GitHub repo nkurniansyah/Alzheimer_PRS (Code, PRSsum_Scaling, Summary_Statistics holding only the same weight file). PGS Catalog REST lookup for PGS0012590 returned an empty record.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: That all individual-level genotypes and outcomes (AD case status, cognitive scores, neuropathology, MRI, CSF biomarkers) sit in NIAGADS (ADSP/ADGC), dbGaP (FHS, MVP phs001672), the Rush RADC request system and All of Us, every one behind an application. Cohort sizes and odds ratios (1.14 to 1.65 per SD) are from the abstract only.

a1_downloadable.note: Controlled access: every labelled, individual-level dataset (NIAGADS ADSP/ADGC, dbGaP FHS/MVP phs001672, Rush RADC, All of Us) needs an application or institutional agreement. The only open files are per-variant PRS (polygenic risk score) weights and analysis scripts, which hold no outcomes.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Not checked further after A1 failed; the open weight file has no outcome column, and AD (Alzheimer's disease) status per person exists only in the controlled cohorts.

a3_inputs_present.note: Not checked further after A1; genotypes are controlled access.

a5_enough_rows.note: Not checked further after A1; no open individual-level rows exist.

a8_label_provenance.note: Not checked further after A1; the open file is itself a model output (PRS-CSx/LDpred2 shrinkage weights), not a measured label.

honest_claim_h3: Not applicable: without individual-level data no model can be trained or tested here.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use a person's genotype and ancestry to predict Alzheimer's disease status or cognitive decline across ancestries.
plain_idea.train_on: Individual genotypes plus ancestry for cohort participants; count unknown because all such data are controlled access.
plain_idea.predict: Clinical Alzheimer's diagnosis or memory scores measured in the cohorts (ADSP, ROSMAP, Framingham, All of Us).
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Better cross-ancestry risk prediction would help trial enrichment in non-European groups, but only cohort holders with approved access could do it.

ml_idea: Cross-ancestry Alzheimer's risk prediction from genotypes, benchmarked against this PRS; infeasible without controlled-access cohort data.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; project fails A1 before any compute question arises.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Check whether any outcome-labelled individual-level data is open: none is (all in NIAGADS, dbGaP, RADC, All of Us).

verdict_reason: A1 fails: all labelled individual-level data (genotypes, AD status, cognition, neuropathology) is controlled access via NIAGADS, dbGaP, Rush RADC and All of Us; the open Zenodo/GitHub release is only a 54.8 MB per-variant PRS weight file plus scripts, with no outcomes to learn from.
